basis.method: Every value-vector case is required by validateValueVectorGate() to carry either a TradingView live-documentation citation or an explicit TealScript local-extension marker. TA, strategy, collection, runtime and language cases must also carry the wider concept documentation sources required for the member surfaces they exercise.
basis.limit: The committed reference snapshot still affects member-name validation, signature/depth accounting and coverage denominators. It is not used as the source of expected output values.

matrixSortCorrection.v2StatementSuperseded: The v2 report called matrix.sort:sort_field a snapshot defect.
matrixSortCorrection.currentFinding: Fuller live-reference checking shows sort_field is documented for UDT matrix sorting, so the issue was incomplete sourcing rather than a phantom parameter.
